description: Northern Ireland Railways Stations is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. A Northern Ireland Railways Station is defined as a railway facility where trains regularly stop to load or unload passengers or goods. A Station generally consists of a platform next to the track and a station building (depot), usually providing related services such as car parking, rest rooms, shops, snacks and ticket sales. Coverage: Northern Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Car Park, Depot, Government, INSPIRE, NI Metadata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
